issues.claim: posthog/admin/admins/user_admin.py:201:the link drops the ticket parameter, and the console operation redirects drop it too, losing the ticket used to prefill the impersonation reason; the ticket-preservation test was deleted.
posthog/admin/console/user_panels.py:154:these handlers ignore form_nonce, which the console requires for message sends; retrying a POST can send another email or rotate a key again.
.github/workflows/release-toolbar-extension.yml:619:publishing is not serialized by store item; an older retry and a newer release can overwrite the shared draft.
.github/workflows/release-toolbar-extension.yml:684:if upload succeeds but submission fails, a retry uploads the same version again and fails; submission cannot be resumed without another upload.
.github/workflows/release-toolbar-extension.yml:290:the pinned action pulls a mutable container tag while holding the release app's write token; the image is not pinned by digest.
Dockerfile.recording-rasterizer:84-88 keeps Debian Bookworm's glibc 2.36, but the new uWebSockets binary loaded by ultimate-express at startup needs glibc 2.38, so the rasterizer crashes at startup.

Automatic production publishing stops: private master pushes and schedules skip the image publishers (MCP, Node, sandbox, rasterizer, replay-anonymizer), and public runs cannot replace them because publishing needs CD_DEPLOY_ENABLED (.github/workflows/cd-mcp-image.yml:37).
Rust builds expand: skipping the affected job leaves an empty filter while build-images survives through !cancelled(), and empty means all images (.github/workflows/rust-docker-build.yml:42).

Desktop-only pushes trigger backend builds and deployments: skipping the changes job leaves an empty verdict that passes posthog_build's != 'false' condition (.github/workflows/container-images-cd.yml:68).
The new GitLab project and merge request methods do not use _json(), so malformed responses do not consistently raise GitLabIntegrationError.
The transport test does not assert the recorded counter and scope; it passes with recording disabled and zero metrics.
The README claims callers honor Retry-After, but the implementation does not.
Devbox sync can run a Git hook from the branch already on the devbox, giving that code access to the forwarded SSH agent; hooks are not disabled during fetch.
Two worktrees can claim the same devbox while it is being created; cleaning either worktree can then delete the other's box.
Git can reuse the same path after a worktree is removed and recreated; cleanup mistakes the new worktree for the old one and can delete the old devbox (identity relies on paths).
The interface checker silently misses aliases and mutated registries (for example `Handed = Plain`, `WORKFLOWS.append(Plain)`).
The ledger ignores consumer identity, so deleting one dependency permits a new, unrelated dependency.

posthog/test/repo_invariants/test_serializer_timestamp_guard.py:274:_serializer_choices() assigns every serializer the view mentions to every write route, so a read-only serializer is reported as a writable-route violation.

posthog/test/repo_invariants/test_serializer_timestamp_guard.py:218:an unresolved serializer factory call (ast.Call) resolves to nothing and the unresolved error is suppressed, so the route passes unchecked.
The tool recomputes the automatic index name hash from current table/column names instead of resolving the existing index from the catalog; named Meta indexes and ambiguity are not handled.
The FK guard rejects a partial btree index with WHERE fk_id IS NOT NULL, although it covers parent-delete lookups without a redundant full index.
